methodology.clean_specification_stage: Agent A records observed upstream behavior only.
methodology.sources: Official GitHub repository files at immutable commit SHAs.
methodology.legacy_evidence_boundary: RUN-007 through RUN-009 were locator hypotheses only.
methodology.eligibility_guard: Only projects with effective COMPLETE_OBSERVER_TRIAGE in RUN-038 were eligible; all seven retained-partial projects were excluded.

results.user_job: Record and review a clinical observation

identity_envelope.edition_boundary: Public repository/ref only; hosted services and uncited modules excluded; no further edition split asserted.

sanitized_behaviour.actor: Authenticated session user possessing the observation-form permission.
preconditions: Active patient and encounter session context.
An existing observation update must resolve within the active patient.
sanitized_behaviour.trigger_input: Save request containing observation fields and optional sub-observations.
sanitized_behaviour.states_transitions: Default preliminary template to validated persisted observation; list and review are filtered by patient, encounter, form, and top-level observation.
sanitized_behaviour.success_postcondition: Main and child observations persist in one declared transaction followed by a saved redirect.
sanitized_behaviour.failure_recovery_retry: Permission or CSRF denial returns 401; invalid data or foreign-patient observation throws; save failure rolls back and returns 500; automatic retry is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.audit_provenance: Durable success audit event is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.concurrency_idempotency: Concurrency locking and idempotency/replay semantics are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.collision_risk: Observation may encompass questionnaires and nested clinical measurements; exact register semantics are not established.

identity_envelope.edition_boundary: Core repository modules only; external OpenMRS modules are excluded.

sanitized_behaviour.actor: Authenticated service caller with add/edit encounter privileges and any encounter-type edit privilege.
preconditions: A new encounter may be assigned a visit through a registered handler.
sanitized_behaviour.states_transitions: New encounter to persisted; existing encounter to updated; related observations, orders, conditions, allergies, and diagnoses are saved or revalidated; separate void and unvoid paths exist.
sanitized_behaviour.success_postcondition: Returns the persisted encounter after cascading the evidenced related records.
sanitized_behaviour.failure_recovery_retry: Missing privilege or a disallowed encounter type throws; explicit user-facing retry and checked-exception rollback policy are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.concurrency_idempotency: Idempotency and row locking are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.collision_risk: An encounter is a compound clinical container; equivalence to an atomic clinical event is not established.

results.user_job: Create, view, update, activate, deactivate, rehire, and invite an employee profile through the canonical identity seam.

identity_envelope.edition_boundary: ERPNext repository only; hosted Frappe Cloud and external Frappe Framework behavior excluded.

sanitized_behaviour.actor: HR User or HR Manager for create/write; linked-user creation additionally checks write permission on the employee record.
preconditions: Automatic user creation requires a preferred, company, or personal email.
Moving to Left requires a relieving date and no active reports.
sanitized_behaviour.trigger_input: Employee insert/update, status change, or linked-user creation request.
sanitized_behaviour.states_transitions: Active, Inactive, Suspended, and Left; non-active employee status disables the linked user and returning to Active re-enables it.
sanitized_behaviour.success_postcondition: Profile persists; an optional linked user is created enabled with Employee role and optional Employee/Company user permissions.
sanitized_behaviour.failure_recovery_retry: Missing email, nonexistent user, duplicate linked active employee, self-reporting, or invalid leaving conditions throw validation errors; retry/recovery workflow is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.audit_provenance: A source comment mentions a linked-user audit log; durable audit-event mechanics are NOT_ESTABLISHED within the inspected repository slice.
sanitized_behaviour.collision_risk: Reactivation mechanics must not be treated as evidenced rehire or invitation semantics.

results.user_job: Review and close an incident under incident journey rules

identity_envelope.edition_boundary: Server/PostgreSQL routes only; standalone/localStorage behavior excluded.

sanitized_behaviour.actor: Authenticated caller with edit authority and access to the referenced project.
preconditions: Closure is reachable only after investigation, root-cause identification, and CAPA creation.
sanitized_behaviour.trigger_input: Update, investigate, root-cause, or create-CAPA request with record ID and relevant payload.
sanitized_behaviour.states_transitions: Detected to investigating to root_cause_identified to capa_created to closed.
sanitized_behaviour.success_postcondition: Closure records actor and time; update, investigation, root cause, and CAPA creation produce separate audit actions.
sanitized_behaviour.failure_recovery_retry: Invalid transition returns 400; missing or inaccessible record returns 404; handler failure returns 500; transactional recovery, retry, and idempotency are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.audit_provenance: Status and lifecycle actions are recorded through audit calls.
sanitized_behaviour.concurrency_idempotency: Concurrency, atomicity across CAPA creation and deviation update, and idempotency are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.scope_privacy: Project accessibility is evidenced; approved-Site scope is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.collision_risk: The source object is a deviation/CAPA workflow, not an incident record; incident equivalence is not established.

results.user_job: Maintain the controlled-drug register and balance

identity_envelope.edition_boundary: Bounded legacy locator inspection only; this is not a repository-wide absence search.

sanitized_behaviour.actor: Prescription-saving caller; exact role authority is NOT_ESTABLISHED in the bounded locus.
preconditions: Inventory is available when dispensing is requested.
sanitized_behaviour.trigger_input: Prescription save with controlled-substance flag and optional generic in-house dispensing request.
sanitized_behaviour.states_transitions: Add or remove a controlled-substance reporting flag; optionally request a generic inventory sale.
sanitized_behaviour.success_postcondition: Bounded prescription flag and optional inventory operation complete.
sanitized_behaviour.failure_recovery_retry: Missing drug, non-positive quantity, missing encounter, unavailable inventory, or service error fails the operation; recovery and retry are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.concurrency_idempotency: Register locking, balance reconciliation, and idempotency are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.scope_privacy: Site scope and witness authority are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.collision_risk: The locus does not establish a controlled-drug register, running balance, witness, discrepancy, receipt, administration, destruction, reconciliation, or append-only audit.

results.user_job: Review allocation history and confirm or reject payment matches

identity_envelope.edition_boundary: Public repository source only; cloud operation excluded.

sanitized_behaviour.actor: Service caller; user-facing role and authorization are NOT_ESTABLISHED in the inspected command.
preconditions: Sources are neither excluded nor already matched.
Matched total equals source total within 0.01.
sanitized_behaviour.trigger_input: One or more uncategorized transaction IDs plus one or more reference type/ID match entries.
sanitized_behaviour.states_transitions: Uncategorized/unmatched source to created match-reference records.
sanitized_behaviour.success_postcondition: Within a unit of work, source rows are locked in deterministic ID order, matchability and totals are validated, match records are created, and matching/matched events are emitted.
sanitized_behaviour.failure_recovery_retry: Invalid or missing references, excluded/already-matched source, or amount mismatch throws; explicit rollback behavior and user retry flow are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
evidenced_controls: Bounded concurrent reference validation and creation.
sanitized_behaviour.concurrency_idempotency: Repeat against an already-matched source is rejected; stable request-key replay is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
sanitized_behaviour.collision_risk: Bank-transaction matching must not be treated as evidenced payment-allocation review/history.
